note: COMMIT B of the two-commit structure declared in ledger/handoffs/TASK-20260810-9dac9a.yaml archive.note. Commit A (348a11b7) staged exactly the two ledger records; this receipt is written afterwards and records A's observed SHA, parent, and per-path digests. Nothing here is self-referential: every value was read off commit A after it existed, and this file is not among the paths it attests. Per CLAUDE.md, archive receipts bind to CONTENT first -- path_sha256 is authoritative and commit reachability is advisory -- so this receipt stays valid if a later merge to main orphans A's SHA; a content mismatch remains fatal. This receipt supersedes NOTHING by editing: the unverifiable TASK-20260731-027 ledger receipt is superseded BY REFERENCE inside DEC-20260810-da7513 (SUP-1) and its bytes are untouched.
